name: Lamborghini
look: True black with gold as the sole accent, extreme uppercase display, zero radius, hexagonal motifs and ghost-outline secondaries.

hero.title: VENTO
hero.sub: A naturally aspirated V12 mounted longitudinally behind the driver, in a carbon monocoque weighing 1,510 kilograms. Two hundred and fifty examples.

features.title: UNCOMPROMISING
features.sub: Every system built for one purpose, and not adapted from anything else.

items.title: V12 ASPIRATED
items.body: Six and a half litres, no forced induction, 820 CV at 8,500 revolutions. The sound is a design requirement, not a by-product.

items.title: CARBON MONOCOQUE
items.body: A single-piece cell produced in Sant'Agata using a forged composite process developed with an aerospace partner.

items.title: ALA AERODYNAMICS
items.body: Active flaps redirect airflow across the rear wing in under half a second, cutting drag on the straight and adding load in the corner.

items.title: 1,510 KG
items.body: Dry weight, with a titanium exhaust, magnesium wheels and a carbon-shelled seat as standard.

items.title: FOUR-WHEEL STEERING
items.body: Rear-axle steering that shortens the wheelbase in slow corners and lengthens it above 120 km/h.

items.title: SQUADRA CORSE
items.body: Developed alongside the racing division at Nardò and Estoril across two seasons.

showcases.title: DEVELOPED ON CIRCUIT
showcases.body: The aerodynamic package, the brake cooling and the gearbox calibration all arrived on the road car because the racing division needed them first. Two seasons of testing at Nardò and Estoril preceded the first customer delivery.
points: Shared aerodynamic package with the GT3 car
Gearbox calibration from the racing programme

showcases.title: NO TWO ARE THE SAME
showcases.body: Four hundred paint finishes, any of which can be matched to a physical sample you bring. Stitching, badging and even the instrument graphics are specified with a designer over two days in Sant'Agata.
points: Over 400 finishes, plus matching to sample
Two days with a designer in Sant'Agata

gallery.title: GALLERY
gallery.sub: Photographed at Sant'Agata Bolognese and on the Passo del Bracco.

testimonial.quote: I asked whether the exhaust could be a little louder above six thousand. Four months later a technician came to my house with two cars and asked me to choose between them.
testimonial.name: Alessandro Ferri

pricing.title: CONFIGURE
pricing.sub: Two hundred and fifty examples. Enquiries are handled by your dealer.

items.a: Through your dealer, in consultation with Sant'Agata. Ownership history is the primary factor, and the Vento allocation closed nineteen days after the announcement.
Approximately five months from confirmed specification for Vento and Performante. An Ad Personam commission runs to roughly nine months.

items.q: Is the V12 really not turbocharged?
items.a: It is naturally aspirated. Forced induction was evaluated and rejected because the throttle response and the sound above six thousand revolutions were considered non-negotiable.
Five years of scheduled maintenance including fluids, filters and collection from an address of your choosing. Track-day consumables are excluded.

cta.title: START CONFIGURATION
cta.sub: Two hundred and fifty examples. Speak to your dealer about allocation.

notes: True black dominates every surface. White and gold are the only relief colours, and gold is the sole chromatic accent in the entire interface.
Gold is reserved exclusively for primary action buttons. Using it on a heading or a background dissolves its function as a signal.
Display type is all-uppercase at extreme scales — 120px, 80px, 54px — with tight line-heights below 1.0.
Zero border-radius on everything. Sharp rectangles are the brand's angular geometry, and a rounded corner reads as a different marque entirely.
The secondary CTA is a transparent ghost button with a white border at 50% opacity. Hexagonal motifs echo the brand geometry in icons and controls.
